text:
Maya: Heads-up: Finance + Legal asked for a clear billing export schema and dispute process tied to SLA credits before we ship pilot consent. Need decisions today.
Priya: I'll own the export schema draft. We should include model_id, model_variant, quant_tag, seq_len_bucket, cache_hit, region, reserved_node_id, request_ts, latency_ms, status_code, billing_tag.
Jon: Add a normalized_latency_ms that strips pre/post-processing so customers can compare models fairly.
Liam: For credit calc: propose deterministic formula: credit = min(committed_amount, usage_amount * max(0, (observed_p99 - sla_p99)/observed_p99)). Keeps it bounded.
Elena: Legal prefers a monthly-window, deterministic denominator, and an audit record that links raw telemetry used for calc. Also need a dispute window (30 days) and a manual review trigger for big credits.
Priya: We'll add a checksum/hash field in the export per-day so Finance can verify raw data hasn't been tampered with: daily_export_hash.
Maya: How do customers dispute?
Liam: Suggested flow: customer opens billing dispute -> we create internal audit job that replays telemetry slice -> 5 business days SLA for resolution -> provisional credit if validated.
Elena: Include an opt-in to allow customers to share telemetry with us for audits; required for credits. Must be in consent.
Jon: Telemetry integrity: instrument request_id and trace_id; store immutable audit logs of raw ingress events for 90 days.
Priya: Sampling: pilot = 100% sampling. GA: we can move to adaptive sampling but exports must still allow accurate monthly aggregates.
Maya: What about retries and retries attribution?
Jon: Count final attempt latency for percentile calc. But include retry_count in export so disputes can inspect.
Liam: Add billing_line_type: reserved, overflow, free_tier, refund_credit so exports map to invoice lines.
Elena: Also need embargo/exclusion rules: maintenance windows, DDoS, customer's misconfiguration. We'll add an exclusions log that links to incidents.
Priya: I'll produce a compact CSV schema and a sample line for docs. Will also include a small SQL example to compute p99 from the export.
Maya: Action owners: Priya -> export schema + sample SQL + checksum approach. Liam -> credit formula draft and dispute flow doc. Elena -> consent wording and legal checklist. Jon -> telemetry tagging + audit-log retention. I'll sign off once docs are uploaded.
ops-bot: Reminder: add the export schema to the runbook for SLA audits: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/sla-audit-export.
Maya: Timeline: drafts today, legal sign-off within 48h, export pipeline test before pilot start.
Liam: One more: cap credits at committed_amount and require manual review if >10% invoice. Agreed?
Elena: Agreed. Add that to consent.
Priya: Posting schema draft to the docs channel in 30m.
Maya: Thanks team 44d
